metadata.description: Build SEO-optimized local business websites with 80-100+ programmatic pages using Astro 5, Tailwind CSS v4, and Cloudflare Pages. Fork of savvity/local-business-builder with fixes: no more fabricated placeholder reviews, corrected a site-wide broken phone-link field, removed a hardcoded-city crash risk, and removed hardcoded reference-site data (schema type, city, county names) that leaked into every generated site.

plugins.name: local-business-builder
plugins.description: Build SEO-optimized local business websites with 80-100+ programmatic pages using Astro 5, Tailwind CSS v4, and Cloudflare Pages. Generates programmatic service/area combination pages, blog infrastructure, real (never fabricated) review handling, schema markup, and internal linking for local search visibility.
